objections.claim: The woven-input mode selector is not deletion-complete: it evaluates changed/added paths using input discovery over the proposed tree, where a deleted woven file no longer exists. A PR that only deletes a previously woven input can therefore select `--historical`, allowing the stale snapshot to pass without a same-PR re-weave. The selector must use the union of base-tree and proposed-tree input discovery and include a deleted-woven-file regression.
